scope: Three reused development studies; no Parse inputs or outcomes. Motivated by post-hoc Parse failure, so no independent validation claim.
outerSplit: Each complete study held out; all 75 donors retained.
selection: Joint penalty .01,.1,1,10,100,infinity and response scale 1,.75,.5,.25,0 using equal-study mean inner MSE; ties prefer smaller scale then larger penalty.
endpoint: Equal-donor mean RMSE per held-out study; at least 5% improvement over unchanged training-mean response and no change, separately in every study.
